title: One screen for every U1 you run.
body: See progress, temperatures and which printer needs attention.
alt: Three simulated U1 printer cards with progress, dock colours and temperatures.
caption: Deja Vu1 brings U1 printer status into one local dashboard. These three printers are simulated; no physical U1 has been connected yet. Try the demo: https://deja-vu1.jmath1110.workers.dev/?demo

eyebrow: Find the next thing to check
title: Which printer needs you?
body: Faults, paused jobs and overdue care, brought into one list.
alt: Needs you lists a dock fault, a paused print and overdue maintenance across a simulated three-printer farm.
caption: A paused job on one U1. A dock fault on another. Needs you puts those separate checks in one list. Actual app, simulated data; real-printer behaviour is still unverified. https://deja-vu1.jmath1110.workers.dev/?demo

title: Keep the plate and its settings together.
body: Edit objects, assign T0–T3 and inspect the sliced layers in one workspace.
alt: Recorded preparation-workspace validation capture with two objects and physical tool assignments.
limit: Separate slicing engine required · physical print unverified
caption: Prepare objects and tool assignments in Deja Vu1, slice through a separately installed compatible engine, then inspect its G-code. Screenshot from recorded Linux workspace validation. It does not establish a physical print. https://github.com/Jbyjre/Deja_VU1/blob/main/docs/slicing-and-models.md

title: A refusal you can read.
body: Review the file, tools and printer. Blocking errors explain why the start is refused.
alt: Confirm Print refuses an unsafe sample file and lists the reasons. Simulated printer.
limit: Checks do not guarantee a successful print
caption: Confirm Print checks the job again on the server when starting. Blocking errors refuse the start; warnings need acknowledgement. This unsafe sample is shown on the simulated farm. These checks are not a guarantee of print success. https://github.com/Jbyjre/Deja_VU1#why-it-exists

eyebrow: Two views of the same printer
title: Follow the head. See the docks.
body: Switch between a 3D model and a drawing. Pick a head for its reported details.
alt: Current 3D printer twin from the app, with simulated readings and estimated body geometry.
limit: Body size and internal geometry estimated
cta: Turn the model in the demo
caption: The digital twin follows reported printer state in a 3D model or engineering drawing. This is a software model, not a camera view. Body size and internal geometry are estimated; the pictured readings are simulated. https://deja-vu1.jmath1110.workers.dev/?demo

title: Have a U1? Help make the first connection.
body: 30–45 minutes. Watch a print you already started and compare its readings.
alt: The dashboard in a 390-pixel Chromium viewport with simulated printer data.
caption: Deja Vu1 has not talked to a physical U1 yet. The first test is watch-only: compare an existing print’s readings without using the dashboard’s printer controls. Allow 30–45 minutes. The phone image is a browser viewport, not a physical-device test. https://github.com/Jbyjre/Deja_VU1/blob/main/docs/first-connection.md
